notes.title: Early Access: Update 9, Patch 2
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/81580fd8080113b0e1e4064a0435dad758d58837.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Greetings, Aces - [/i][/p][p]Today’s quick update smooths out a few rough edges. We fixed a loading screen hang up, tightened class-and-skill interactions, and made a few minor changes to enemy behavior, and more.[/p][p]Check out the details, below.[/p][p]_______[/p][h2]Gameplay & Exploration[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game could get stuck on the loading screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Weapon Skill Activate Shortcut prompt would not update properly when keyboard keybinds were changed [/p][/*][/list][h2]Classes & Combat[/h2][list][*][p]Sentinel[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the hitsettings of certain launcher attacks so that they work better in conjunction with the Boomguard’s Legacy perk[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Pyroclast[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the final hit of Crimson Uppercut so that it’s easier to perform follow up attacks[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Rockbreaker[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the hitsettings of certain launcher attacks so that they work better in conjunction with the Boomguard’s Legacy perk[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Shadowstriker[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Shadow Dancer Skill did not properly work on critical hits caused by the dagger hits from Shadow Feint[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could buffer into attacks during Lightning Step and skip the lightning blast caused by the Echoblades Legendary perk.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Umbra[/p][list][*][p]Iska[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where controller vibration on hit would occur for all players instead of just for the player performing the action[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Enemies[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Average and Elite tier Tailwhippers could evade at DL1 and DL2[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Pangojira was able to be stunned indefinitely under specific circumstances[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Totems spawned by the Gobo Tormentor would flash repeatedly when hit by a status effect[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where the game could get stuck on the loading screen
- Fixed an issue where the Weapon Skill Activate Shortcut prompt would not update properly when keyboard keybinds were changed

tags.balance_change: - Adjusted the hitsettings of certain launcher attacks so that they work better in conjunction with the Boomguard’s Legacy perk
- Adjusted the final hit of Crimson Uppercut so that it’s easier to perform follow up attacks
- Adjusted the hitsettings of certain launcher attacks so that they work better in conjunction with the Boomguard’s Legacy perk

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where the Shadow Dancer Skill did not properly work on critical hits caused by the dagger hits from Shadow Feint
- Fixed an issue where you could buffer into attacks during Lightning Step and skip the lightning blast caused by the Echoblades Legendary perk.
- Fixed an issue where controller vibration on hit would occur for all players instead of just for the player performing the action
- Fixed an issue where Average and Elite tier Tailwhippers could evade at DL1 and DL2
- Fixed an issue where Pangojira was able to be stunned indefinitely under specific circumstances
- Fixed an issue where Totems spawned by the Gobo Tormentor would flash repeatedly when hit by a status effect

notes.title: Early Access: Update 9, Patch 1 – Class & Combat Bug Fixing
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/5a52afcf87e2f6f505624be525fb0ea7d6d6072b.png"][/img][i]Greetings, Aces![/i][/p][p]This patch sharpens your swings, steadies your perks, and squashes some pesky bugs … Launcher behavior is tighter, Focus gains are smoother, and issues—like revive hiccups, UI oddities, and Request Board mix-ups—have been cleaned up.[/p][p]Check out details below. As always, your feedback helps shape these updates—keep it coming![/p][hr][/hr][h2]Combat & Gameplay[/h2][list][*][p][b]Combat HUD[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed instances of the Combat Mini HUD disappearing when performing certain actions (drinking a Flask, using a Focus Skill, using an Umbra, etc)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the enemy’s healthbar would animate smoothly when attacked (this now behaves the way that it used to prior to Update 9)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player can start/skip part of the revive process before the pop-up appears[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Boomguard Legacy[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused Boomguard Legacy’s perk to not work with the Rockbreaker universal launcher attack.[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the launch trajectory of the explosion so that it’s easier to do combos.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the launch timing so that it’s easier to perform follow up combos.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Request Board[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where an incorrect number of Launchers were required to complete the Ready to Launch request.[/p][list][*][p]This requires 20 launchers instead of 30.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Classes & Allies[/h2][list][*][p][b]Sentinel[/b][/p][list][*][p]Heavy Combo Finisher (HHH) is now considered a launcher and should work in conjunction with perks like Boomguard’s Legacy[/p][/*][*][p]Explosion from Sanguine Burst no longer knocks enemies far away and now applies the same type of launch opportunities as the normal HHH combo finisher[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Shadowstriker[/b][/p][list][*][p]Meter gain from basic attacks have been slightly improved to accommodate for the recent fixes to Focus Meter gain from certain perks. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]McKraken[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Atoll Oasis Focus Meter gain effect did not work if the Ace was in air[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Ryx[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused Ryx to remain stationary in missions if the Ace teleports to other party members[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Ryx does not join the player to fight the Gobo Impaletail in the Snaggleshire Venture[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

tags.bug: Fixed instances of the Combat Mini HUD disappearing when performing certain actions (drinking a Flask, using a Focus Skill, using an Umbra, etc)
Fixed an issue where the enemy’s healthbar would animate smoothly when attacked (this now behaves the way that it used to prior to Update 9)
Fixed an issue where the player can start/skip part of the revive process before the pop-up appears
Fixed an issue that caused Boomguard Legacy’s perk to not work with the Rockbreaker universal launcher attack.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted the launch trajectory of the explosion so that it’s easier to do combos.
Adjusted the launch timing so that it’s easier to perform follow up combos.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where an incorrect number of Launchers were required to complete the Ready to Launch request.

tags.balance_change: This requires 20 launchers instead of 30.

tags.feature: Heavy Combo Finisher (HHH) is now considered a launcher and should work in conjunction with perks like Boomguard’s Legacy

tags.balance_change: Explosion from Sanguine Burst no longer knocks enemies far away and now applies the same type of launch opportunities as the normal HHH combo finisher
Meter gain from basic attacks have been slightly improved to accommodate for the recent fixes to Focus Meter gain from certain perks.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where Atoll Oasis Focus Meter gain effect did not work if the Ace was in air
Fixed an issue that caused Ryx to remain stationary in missions if the Ace teleports to other party members
Fixed an issue where Ryx does not join the player to fight the Gobo Impaletail in Snaggleshire Venture

notes.title: Early Access: Update 9 - New! Community Requests
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/561461f61b71d0cf33869d1b725b489ba14edcf1.png"][/img][i]Greetings, Aces![/i][/p][p]In addition to a suite of class, combat, and enemy tweaks, we’ve got some new things for you to try in this update—starting with a brand-new system we’re calling Community Requests, plus a major refresh to how you earn Writs throughout the game.[/p][list][*][p][b]New Feature! Community Requests[/b]: Community Requests are now live! These time-limited challenges invite all Aces to contribute toward a shared goal. Each request includes personal objectives for you to tackle on your own, plus large-scale Belfry-wide milestones. [/p][list][*][p]You’ll find Community Requests in the Request Board in the Tower under the new Community tab. The first event, Rakentague Overflow, focuses on Grasslands missions, Beastkin, and Bloodletters … more detail below! [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Writ Reward Updates: [/b]We’ve fine-tuned how Writs are earned across early missions and the Job Board to help smooth out the path for new and returning Aces. More on Writs and in-game economy soon ... for now, here's what you can expect with this update. [/p][list][*][p]For rookie Aces just stepping into Towerborne, the early game grind has been lightened to get you moving faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Several early missions now reward 400 Writs (up from 250)[/p][/*][*][p]Job Board tasks now scale from 80 to 160 Writs based on difficulty. [/p][/*][*][p]Requests have also been made more flexible—no need to hunt down one exact Venture anymore; now you can take on [i]any[/i] Venture and still make progress. [/p][/*][*][p]The Bell questline has been refreshed - complete it again to earn extra Writs.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Check out update details, below.[/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]New Feature! [/b][/h2][h3]Community Requests [/h3][p][b]Community Request: Rakentague Overflow[/b][/p][p][i]A tide of enemies is coming from the Rakentague area. The Council has deemed this threat to be Ace Level, and bounties are issued. Help protect the refugees in the area! [/i][/p][p]Community Requests are a new feature added to Towerborne in this update. This is a 3 week challenge. Each step unlocks automatically after the step before it is completed. Work together as a Community to complete the new Request to claim rewards![/p][p][b]Ace Goals[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Complete 5 missions in Grasslands[/p][/*][*][p]Defeat 200 Beastkin[/p][/*][*][p]Complete the Rakentague Venture[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Belfry Goals[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Complete 1000 missions in Grasslands[/p][/*][*][p]Defeat 10000 Beastkin[/p][/*][*][p]Defeat 1000 Ratslasher Bloodletters[/p][/*][/olist][p]Community Requests can be found in the Request Board located in the Tower. Tab over to the Community section to see the new additions to the board. Rewards can be claimed at the board (for each step). At the end of the event, you’ll be sent unclaimed rewards automatically via in-game mail. [/p][p][b][i]Beastkin[/i][/b][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/ac8eb3e2418788684cdf67d8c65f181ac2ee094a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/b7c63a4f2e788eebe1830ffa35aae6bc47d3aed5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/a8a7c11f615a6aa8ce6dec48280a1932ff599b8d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/f4c10573149288595c5389a59ad7f823b4ccecef.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/60854aae117d50ca7d23ff469774324b0e8dc6c7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/cd7295fc79a43f8f1679f2acb26da6d1ee91ce84.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/397513305df996e8f25666596b2c884fb71e0da9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/f9638677b1b3276a21e34f053693d8c52d9b725b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/7da2c774773755176541560cc1d216ab13e63e6a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/77918ba41fa7341e806527547f3fdc7f712be012.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/0423d71bb149dd1ab98a6913d8f3301817acb4d9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/c2384016c433db2143a9637c33fab9be26cacff7.png"][/img][/carousel][p][b][i]Ratslasher Bloodletter[/i][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/2cac4d11b7fe69bde0bff260d18eb595859de30b.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Game Updates[/b][/h2][h3]Classes & Combat[/h3][p]Similar to our previous update, there has been a large focus on bug fixes and quality of life improvements in the combat space. The revive co-op experience in particular has received an overhaul which should alleviate frustrating moments. Combat also has received a substantial number of changes that will make things feel better across the board. Some of the changes are subtle but they all add up to make something that feels a lot more consistent. [/p][list][*][p][b]Death / Revive Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]The revive meter now decays over time instead of resetting when revive is canceled[/p][/*][*][p]It is now possible for multiple Aces to revive a downed player, which also increases how fast it takes to revive players[/p][/*][*][p]Gear Updates to account for Death / Revive changes[/p][list][*][p]McKracken’s Pride Legendary revive aspects have been replaced[/p][/*][*][p]Revive Ally affixes grant HP now[/p][/*][*][p]Revive Ally Duration affix now grants DEF instead[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ace Stats[/p][list][*][p]“Revive Ally HP” and “Revive Ally Time” stats have been removed[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Classes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sentinel[/p][list][*][p]Improved gameplay feel of all attacks.[/p][list][*][p]Heavy -> Light combo tree has been improved significantly[/p][/*][*][p]It is easier to cancel into Launcher and Block Breaker following a Light Combo Finisher[/p][/*][*][p]Cancel windows of all attacks have been adjusted to feel snappier[/p][/*][*][p]Hitbox sizes have been adjusted to alleviate issues where attacks could whiff midcombo [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Increased the amount of Weapon Meter generated from attacks[/p][/*][*][p]It is now possible to cancel Combo Finishers with Universal Launcher and Universal Block Breaker attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Heavy Combo Finisher hit reaction has been changed to allow for follow up attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Heavy Combo Finisher no longer launches enemies super far away, making it easier to perform combos[/p][/*][*][p]Hit reactions on some attacks have been adjusted so that it’s easier to perform combos in general[/p][/*][*][p]Steady Strikes - Increased speed of attacks so that it feels snappier[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the hitbox of Shield Toss so that it’s more tags.bug: Fixed an issue where Steady Strikes only applied 3 seconds of bleed instead of 4 when The Butcher is equipped
Fixed an issue where Dashing Skewer did not apply the correct number of bleed stacks when The Crimson Reaver is equipped
Fixed an issue with The Erudite Legendary Weapon that caused Crownbreaker to not grant 1 bar of Focus Meter when used in the air
Fixed an issue where Blazing Roar did not cause Burn when the Ironflower Legendary is equipped
Fixed an issue where Stable Footing did not activate when Sear is performed in the air
Fixed an issue where Crimson Uppercut would still hit even after the visual disappeared
Fixed an issue where Feral’s Nightmare passive did not properly allow for Air Heavy Attack follow ups to cause a bonus explosion
Fixed an issue where the a level 2 Powderkeg Punch did not function properly when using the Stone Cold Skill
Fixed an issue that caused level 3 Powderkeg Punch and Bare Knuckle Blast to not cause Stun
Fixed an issue where Powderkeg Punch did not fill to level 3 when defeating a blocking enemy with Cracking Skulls equipped
Fixed an issue where the bonus damage from Shock and Awe was not applied on enemies affected by Vulnerability
Fixed an issue that caused Air Heavy to abruptly end if performed right before landing after a jump
Fixed an issue where Death Veil conflicted with Smoke Veil

Fixed an issue that caused specific Focus Skills with projectiles to activate Focus related perks for each projectile instead of only once per move activation

Fixed an issue that caused the hitbox of the Ring of Fire to be misaligned
This issue is also fixed in missions where the Ring of Fire is a persistent Hazard
Fixed an issue where you go through the enemy when it was in the recovery frames of certain attacks, making it harder to perform combos
Fixed an issue where you can parry the bear trap explosion.
Fixed an issue that caused the enemies to not deal damage to wagons
Fixed an issue that prevented Shield Gobos from being block broken during their shield push attack

notes.title: Early Access: Update 8, Patch 1 - Class & Gear Fixes
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/b8ebaee7ee8697811556e56a4dd0ee95bc679f82.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Greetings, Aces![/i][/p][p]We’ve tightened up combat, gear, and gobos alike to keep every swing, slash, and setting feeling just right. Today’s patch is all about [i]precision[/i]—cleaner status effects, smarter enemies, and quality-of-life tweaks that make Towerborne run smoother while we cook up the next big thing.[/p][p]Shipping these fixes ended up causing some other issues ... as of now, [url="https://www.towerborne.com/loot-rush/"]Loot Rush[/url] wrapped a week earlier than planned—for those dodge-roll hungry Aces scooping up shinys, our humblest apologies for the rug-pull! We know that caught some of you mid-run, but please know that we’ll be leveling up systems across the board.[/p][p]No matter what - your feedback on any Limited-Time Mode, or anything for that matter - drives our next steps; keep it coming! 
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Classes & Combat[/h2][list][*][p]Class Skills[/p][list][*][p]Sentinel[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused bleed from Prickly Strikes received from Sanguine Assault to only lasts for 2 seconds instead of 4 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused Sanguine Assault to activate after exploding 6 stacks of bleed instead of 5[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused Bleed inflicted by Shield Surf to last 3 seconds instead of 4 seconds[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Pyroclast[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused Stable Footing to not provide Stability for the correct duration[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Rockbreaker[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused Focus Skill related perks to not function properly when using the Jackhammer Focus Skill[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Shadowstriker[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused Shooting Stars to apply double the amount of status effects per projectile hit[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Gear[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the Shroom Ventilator Legendary helmet to apply permanent Poison Immunity[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Duelist Legendary Weapon that caused stun to apply 100% of the time instead of 20%[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Crimson Reaver Legendary Weapon did not apply Vulnerability[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Enemies[/h2][list][*][p]Gobo Impaletail[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the tail whip attack to cause a knockdown on Block Break[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Gobo Tormentor[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the buff totems to spawn much more frequently than intended[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Various AI ticketing improvements across all enemies[/p][/*][/list][h2]Art & UX[/h2][list][*][p]Time to complete and total score (where applicable) is now displayed on the End of Mission recap screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Changes made to Settings no longer revert after linking accounts[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Fixed an issue that caused bleed from Prickly Strikes received from Sanguine Assault to only lasts for 2 seconds instead of 4 seconds

notes.title: Early Access: Update 8 - Echoes of Gratitude
notes.content:
[p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44237228/25a69c519461beb2773d930548c3baf5359983d3.png"][/img][i]Greetings, Aces![/i][/p][p]From the moment Towerborne hit Early Access last September—and through April’s game-shaping update—you’ve been with us [b]every swing of the Warclub[/b]. You’ve toppled titans, lit up [b]Umbra Shrines[/b], leveled classes, and traded war stories in the Belfry. We set out to build a game we wanted to play, and we knew it would only reach its full potential with you right beside us.[/p][p]That spirit fuels our latest (massive) update-celebration, [b]Echoes of Gratitude.[/b] From bug-hunting to every “hey, what if…?” our Founders - those Aces who've played with us on our road to 1.0 launch - have helped sculpted Towerborne into what it is today, and like any good squad-mate, we've got your back![/p][h3]Update 8 Overview[/h3][p]With this update, expect a bigger world and a deeper game, including a new Danger Level 5 zone, new Ventures, new Chance Encounters, new enemies and a new Umbra - and more. Quality of life improvements include early runs feeling smoother, fewer pop-ups, a rebalanced DL 2 trial, cleaner mission flow, and more.  [/p][previewyoutube="FZ5NQCpDY6w;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]Echoes of Gratitude Celebration[/h3][p]To show our thanks, we’re throwing the Belfry doors wide open for[b] a week of Free Play Days[/b]! Yes, it’s exactly like it sounds … play for free on Steam (June 11–18) or Xbox (June 12–18) - these Free Play Days serve two purposes: first, a big thank-you! And second, they’ll help us test our systems to make sure we ship the best possible game when we officially launch - [i]for everyone! [/i]Beyond that, we’ve lined up a slate of in game (and out-of-game) goodies – see the full list below![/p][p]Give it all a whirl and - as always - we can’t wait to hear what you think.[/p][p]__________[/p][h1][b]Echoes of Gratitude[/b][/h1][p]We hope all of what we’ve got in store resonates with you - each item below is a version of our way of saying - thank you for suiting up alongside us![/p][h3]Jump Into Free Play Days! (limited time)[/h3][p]Towerborne will be free to play on Steam (June 11-18) [i]and [/i]Xbox (June 12-18). No codes. No hoops. Just jump in and play! Couch co-op just got a bit cozier. Founders with those laggard pals - have them join the squad! Additionally, Towerborne is on sale across platforms (for a limited time) - if you’ve been waiting to become a Founder yourself, this is a great time to do it.[/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44237228/8ad81329c3ae816dce7812b6a74652842d434bd9.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Update 8 is Here![/h3][p]We are building Towerborne to grow and evolve over time. In just the months leading up to our launch, we can probably say that we've grown significantly. And, with your continued input and feedback - we plan to keep it rolling. Update 8 is a big step in converting feedback into meaningful changes, including: combat tuning, UX polish, and measurable balance changes that we feel will improve the overall experience. Check out the details, below![/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44237228/5fd5ee21e6e6a35b8ffe634d4814f1785a52d5bb.png"][/img][/p][h3]New: Discord Quests![/h3][p]We partnered with Discord for a special limited-time Quest. From June 11 to June 18, completing the Quest while playing Towerborne will unlock an exclusive Shiro avatar to use on Discord. [/p][list][*][p][b]Go [url="https://discord.com/quests/1376963111847727144"]here [/url]to grab the Quest via Discord![/b] [/p][/*][*][p]For a primer on how Discord Quests work, go [url="https://www.towerborne.com/discordquests"]here[/url]. [/p][/*][*][p]This reward is available to all players on Steam and Xbox.[/p][/*][/list][previewyoutube="EeAdALHihIc;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]Curio Favorites Return for a Limited Time![/h3][p]Shiro’s Stash was originally set to rotate out a month ago – but thanks to the support from the community, we’ve extended the window through June 18! We’re also bringing back two fan-favorite Curios. The originally event-timed Nightcloak’s Vault and the Glacial Hoard Curio are making an appearance for a limited time. Grab these iconic cosmetics before they cycle out![/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44237228/db887d064005e3abff1900504abbc8d0b929fbe7.png"][/img][/p][h3]Twitch Drops: Final Chance, Full Unlock[/h3][p]We are so thankful to all the creators who have streamed Towerborne and to everyone who has watched and supported the game along the way. This current week (June 11-18) is also your chance to scoop up a full Twitch Drop gear set … take that, FOMO! [b]For more details on how to participate - go [url="https://www.towerborne.com/twitchdrops-0625/"]here[/url].[/b] [/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44237228/bec3ab22ef12cf5f51f8848d3bb64e5325dca16e.png"][/img][/p][h3]New! Belfry Heroes Wallpaper[/h3][p]What’s that you say? The art of Towerborne is so compelling you want it plastered across your screens?! Don’t worry, we got you! We’re keeping it going with a [i]brand-new [/i][b]Heroes of the Belfry [/b]wallpaper set in full 4K resolution. All of our wallpaper, old and new, you can find [url="https://www.towerborne.com/media"]here[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44237228/491c454dcd246067afd770bb065030cfca4f95ce.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Gratitude = Prizes[/h3][p]Two Umbra. Two cozy blankets. One lucky winner … Which one of your skilled lucky Aces will conquer this [i]Sweepstakes-[/i]Shrine?! Enter the contest [url="https://gleam.io/SvKq0/towerborne-echoes-of-gratitude-contest"]here[/url] (runners up will get their hands on either 2,000 Belfry Bucks or a Curio Core! Open to US Residents, only). [/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44237228/ba0590dcfed5fb6cc3dc787be4be3b1f5eb66869.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h1][b]Update 8 Details[/b][/h1][p]A stiff breeze is rolling in from the mountains … and along with it, a fresh [b]zone for Danger Levels 4 and 5[/b], new Ventures, new Chance Encounters, and a new enemy to test your mettle too. There is more game to play and world to explore - and you'll have a better time  doing it. This update also delivers relatively smoother runs overall. New players have a faster experience learning the game—fewer pop-ups, a rebalanced License 2 trial, and better mission-to-mission flow. Couch co-op squads now share quest steps while everyone hunts for new Legendary weapons, gear sets – and last but not least, a new Umbra ally to join your fight. [/p][p]Here are the details:[/p][h3]Gameplay & Exploration[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44237228/26a58792f38e675945113698f527134690b87d98.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]New map expansion![/p][list][*][p]New location opened up to the northeast of Numbers for Danger Levels 4 and 5[/p][/*][*][p]2 New Ventures[/p][/*][*][p]6 New Chance Encounters[/p][/*][*][p]1 New Umbra Shrine[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Enemy - Merk Trickster[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Bait and Clear missions[/p][list][*][p]Bait and Clear missions are now repeatable[/p][/*][*][p]A new Bait and Clear has been added to Danger Level 2[/p][/*][*][p]There is now a new questline to complete Bait and Clear missions for Writs. notes.title: Krafft’s Gauntlet: Best the Boss Blitz!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/2c69d8babc25822a33d3b4a2a30079142a7de750.png[/img]
[i]Greetings, Ace - 
[/i]
Commander Krafft is sounding the alarm: a limited-time boss rush mode that’ll drag every campaign big-bad back into the ring—one after another, no rest, no do-overs. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S_Nx5Y5Njw4]Starting today, every campaign boss you thought you’d left in the dust is lining up for a rematch—back-to-back, no breaks[/url]. Clear the Gauntlet before June 11 - or be stuck having to hear about the heroes who did!
[list]
[*] [b]Limited-Time Mode Start Time:[/b] Jun 4, 2025 - 8am PT / 11am ET
[*][b] Limited-Time Mode End Time: [/b]Jun 11, 2025  - 6am PT / 9am ET
[/list]
[previewyoutube=S_Nx5Y5Njw4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]How to Jump In[/h2]
To enter the Gauntlet - you must complete Heart of Numbers, first. Then, head to Commander Krafft and accept his charge. 
[list]
[*][b] Gather Your Squad:[/b] Bring friends. Everything’s better (and louder) with your team.
[*][b] Brace for the boss barrage: [/b]The battle order should feel familiar … just with a spotlight on boss encounters. Vanquishing each boss will give you rewards - but little respite. Make it count. 
[*] [b]Turn up the challenge:[/b] The Gauntlet has two paths … if the standard Boss Blitz is a cake walk, dare to take on the Super Boss Blitz mode for an even tougher test of your mettle. 
[/list]
[h2]Tips From the Front 
[/h2]Even veteran Aces can use an edge. Keep these pointers in your back pocket and you might survive long enough to gloat…
[list]
[*] [b]Mind the clock.[/b] A ‘count up’ timer keeps track of your runs - and separates legends from wannabes. 
[*] [b]Control the chaos.[/b] Super Boss Blitz may bring more baddies to the battlefront … be mindful of skills and combos that can help keep them in check.
[*] [b]Plan your potions.[/b] You get one refill per win—coordinate or crash.
[*][b] Bring friends[/b]. Everything’s better (and louder) with a full squad.
[/list]
Go find Commander Krafft - The Gauntlet awaits!

notes.title: Early Access: Update 7 - Classes & Crucibles
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/87fec42a59cba9897dd2d17e1abf61d4029b0193.png[/img]
[i]Greetings, Aces!
[/i]
Update 7 features a renewed Time Trials Limited Time Mode we're calling Courage's Crucible – which'll be a brand new challenge for all of you Founders who've jumped into the fray over the past few weeks. 

Alongside Courage's Crucible - we're delivering plenty of quality of life improvements along with critical refinements to new Class Skills.  Beyond gameplay upgrades, expect these regular patch notes to spotlight style upgrades, too … scroll to the bottom for the latest on new Curio contents.

We're excited to keep our pre-1.0 momentum going … and have an even bigger content update we're working hard on slated for this June.

[i]Here's what Update 7 has to offer[/i]:[list] 	[*][b]Class Skills Tuning:[/b] Sharpen your edge with rebalanced and refined Class Skills, ensuring every class feels uniquely powerful and rewarding. Dive into missions and experience improved combat flow firsthand.[/*] 	[*][b]Courage's Crucible:[/b] Test your skills against waves of foes - and the clock. See Courage to delve into this limited-time mode, available for the next two weeks. Survive the onslaught and earn bragging rights and rewards.[/*] 	[*][b]Quality of Life Enhancements:[/b] With your feedback in hand, we've made improvements to enhance the experience. Expect smoother interactions, refined UI, and seamless adventure management.[/*][/list][h2][b]Gameplay & Exploration[/b][/h2][b]Limited Time Mode - Courage's Crucible[/b]: Time Trials is back but with a new name and a whole bunch of new improvements! The biggest improvement is the introduction of the Courage Stockpile. As you play through Courage's Crucible you will earn Clashmarks that then allow you to unlock a variety of Cosmetics and other goodies, including Writs! If you missed out on getting the Courage Cosmetic set now is your chance to get them. We also added Cosmetics for Rockbreaker, Pyroclast, and Shadowstriker as well.  [list] 	[*]Courage's Stockpile Store! Gain clashmarks by playing Courage's Crucible to unlock rewards[/*] 	[*]Fixed an issue with Projectile Strikes in Courage's Crucible that allowed the projectiles to be parried by enemies[/*] 	[*]Shrines are now always permanent buffs. Detailed descriptions now exist for each Shrine[list] 	[*]Extended Focus: Increases the Focus Meter by 1.[/*] 	[*]Extra Time: Add 25 seconds to the clock![/*] 	[*]Airborne DMG Up: Increases damage of airborne combos by 5%.[/*] 	[*]Break Bar DMG Up: Increases Break Bar DMG by 10%.[/*] 	[*]Crit Chance Up: Increases the chance of scoring a critical hit by 10%.[/*] 	[*]DMG Up: Increases damage dealt by 10%.[/*] 	[*]DEF Up: Increases defense by 10%.[/*] 	[*]Mending Potency: Flask Healing +10%.[/*] 	[*]HP Up: Increases Max HP by 500.[/*] 	[*]Extra Umbra Charge: Increases number of Umbra Charges by 1.[/*] 	[*]Focus Gain Up: Increases Focus Gain per hit by 10%.[/*] 	[*]Mender's Boon: Increases Flask Uses by 1.[/*] 	[*]Speed Up: Permanently increases movement speed by 5%.[/*] 	[*]Umbra Strength Up: Increases Umbra Strength by 10%.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Ebb Crystals spawn through gameplay to provide temp buffs. These are always 45 seconds[list] 	[*]Might!: Gives Might[/*] 	[*]Explosive Dash!: Dash and Dodge causes explosions[/*] 	[*]Focus Shockwave!: Focus Skills cause Shockwaves[/*] 	[*]Haste!: Gives haste.[/*] 	[*]Lightning Dash!: Dash and Dodge causes Lightning to spawn[/*] 	[*]Lightning Jump!: Jumping causes Lightning to spawn[/*] 	[*]Unlimited Umbra: Gives unlimited umbra use[/*] 	[*]Projectile Strikes!: Attacks cause projectiles to spawn[/*] 	[*]Stunny Strikes!: Strikes have a chance to stun enemies[/*] 	[*]Focus Regen!: Focus meter auto regenerates[/*] 	[*]Venom Strikes!: Attacks deal poison[/*] 	[*]Fired Up!: Attacks deal fire[/*] 	[*]Prickly Strikes!: Attacks deal bleed[/*] 	[*]Stink Mist: Leaves poison cloud[/*][/list][/*][/list][list] 	[/list][h2][b]Classes & Combat[/b][/h2]It's been awesome seeing everyone enjoying the Class Mastery system added in Update 6. There's been a lot of great feedback already! For this update, we're largely keeping things light. Most of the changes that you'll see below are bug fixes. In some cases, some numbers were just too high and very obviously needed to be normalized. It's an important philosophy of ours to make sure that the changes we make do not make the game less fun to play. We want to encourage exploration, encourage excitement when it comes to build crafting.  In addition to bug fixes, we also made a decision that Launchers should just be an innate Skill. It didn't quite feel right not having this ability right off the bat. As a result, you'll now have a few more Skill Points to use for other Skills!

notes.title: Upcoming Events: May-July
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/e89ba934829517ea2e97f59bfb6a6c602288d473.png[/img]
[i]Greetings, Aces - 
[/i]
Over the next [i]six weeks[/i] we’re unleashing a [b]mix of game modes and events – [/b]time-trials, boss rushes, new world to explore, and more! Here's a pocket guide along with a flashy graphic so you can plot your path through it all … snag your pals, stay nimble, sharpen your loadouts, and get ready to stack those Writs. There’s a fresh challenge almost every week.

[h2][b]Mark your calendars!
[/b][/h2]

Here’s the list of what to expect (and it’s not even all of it!) in the coming weeks. We aren’t just adding new cosmetics, we’re deepening gameplay and expanding the world, too. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/be7fd9ee139930cc306ed248049a84f11bd126e1.png[/img]

[b]More to [/b][u][b]EXPLORE[/b][/u][b]:[/b] more map to master, more mysteries to meet: [list] [*] [b]Jun 11: Merk Mountain[/b] -- A permanent zone packed with tougher mobs, rare loot, and new story beats. [*] [b]July TBA: Shorebreeze[/b] -- For a limited time, enjoy a Summer vacation! Don't worry, you'll be awash in details soon enough. [/list] 
[b]More ways to [/b][u][b]FIGHT[/b][/u]: Limited-time challenges that test your mettle. [list] [*] [b]May 21 – Jun 4: Courage’s Crucible [/b] -- Time-trial gauntlet—smash hourglasses, beat the clock, and snag Courage-themed rewards. [*] [b]Jun 4 – Jun 11: Krafft’s Gauntlet[/b] -- Boss-rush frenzy with nonstop danger—ideal for min-maxers and co-op synergy tests. [/list] 
[b]More [/b][u][b]LOOT[/b][/u]: Cosmetics & perks events to level up your style. For a Twitch Drop how-to, go [url=http://www.towerborne.com/twitchdrops][u]here[/u][/url]. [list] [*] [b]May 13 – May 20: Ebb-Knight’s Cape (Twitch Drop)[/b] [*] [b]May 20 – May 27: Ebb-Knight’s Surcoat (Twitch Drop) [/b] [*] [b]May 23 – May 26: Wild Writs Weekend 2 [/b] -- Danger Level 3-5 Ventures grant double Writs, speeding up cosmetic unlocks.[url=https://www.towerborne.com/writs-weekend/?utm_source=chatgpt.com] [/url][b] [/b] [*] [b]May 27 – Jun 3: Ebb-Knight’s Shin Guard (Twitch Drop) [/b] [*] [b]Jun 3 – Jun 17: Ebb-Knight’s Wrath (Twitch Drop) [/b] [*] [b]Jun 18 - July 2: Loot Rush[/b] -- Outsmart obstacles. Collect coins. Get cool stuff! [b] [/b] [/list]
We want to make good on our promise to give you a ton to do on our path to 1.0 launch - to learn from you, what works, and what doesn’t. So keep the feedback coming - [url=https://discord.gg/towerborne][u]join the community conversation via Discord.[/u][/url] 

Expect more detail on all of these to come … in the meantime, mark those calendars - and mark your friends’ calendars, too! ‘Cause each of these moments is guaranteed to be better with your squad. [b] [/b]

notes.title: Road to 1.0: Retroactive Achievements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/118b806f00a514f91de3d43ccaf3ee0f911be4bf.png[/img]

Hey, Founders - 

First, thank you. This week Towerborne hit a big milestone by arriving on Xbox Game Preview - inviting more Aces to join the adventure, and we couldn’t be more excited to welcome everyone to the Belfry!
During Early Access, Towerborne has grown tremendously and there’s plenty of game to play and bragging rights to earn. We know many of you are wondering about when we will turn on [b]Achievements[/b], and we want to share our plan with you.

[b]TL;DR: Achievements are coming and, yes, they will be retroactive![/b] 

As we work toward the inevitable 1.0 release, we’ve been preparing a full [b]Achievement list[/b] that will go live simultaneously across all platforms. These Achievements will honor your progress, skill, and the adventures you've taken throughout the world of Towerborne—and we want to make sure they truly matter. 

We realize that it is incredibly important that [b]every Achievement be retroactive[/b]. That means anything you’re doing [b]right now[/b]—whether it's mastering a class, exploring the world, or besting an Umbra’s test—[b]will be remembered[/b] and count toward unlocking Achievements the moment they go live. 

If you've already met the requirements, the Achievement will automatically be granted. No need to replay content or grind things out again. No matter what platform you play on, the Achievements will be the same. We’ll have more information to share in a future update about what you can expect from those. 

[h3]Your Progress is Important and Permanent
[/h3]
We also want to reassure you: [b]there will be no more wipes[/b], resets, or loss of progress moving forward. All progression, gear, weapons, Umbra, and future achievements are yours to build upon going forward. 

Your feedback, support, and enthusiasm have helped shape Towerborne into what it is today, and they will continue to guide us as we continue to make this game for you!

So what are you waiting for? Your legacy isn’t going to build itself…

notes.title: Update 6: Class Mastery & Cross Progression Arrive!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/3e362cb84fc3787afda504b51608b2411f5c590e.png[/img]

[i]Greetings (and welcome!), Aces! [/i][/b]

Today, rookie Aces join the ranks - because New Class Skills, Cross-play, Cross Progression, and Console Couch Co-Op (Xbox only) are all here! All at once!

[previewyoutube=dez6x0vFqiw;full][/previewyoutube] 

New and deeper gameplay is here alongside our Xbox Game Preview debut—so whether you’ve been brawling since Steam Early Access or you’re hopping in on Game Pass, you’ll find deeper progression, more ways to play, and couch co-op on console (only on console for now) for the first time. 

With the new Class Skills system, we’re also delivering a special Limited Time Event:[url=https://www.towerborne.com/shiros-golden-journey/] Shiro’s Golden Journey.[/url] And hey, if you want to give your thumbs a break from all the Gobo bashing button mashing, why not sit back and flip on a Towerborne Twitch stream so you can grab yourself a [url=www.towerborne.com/twitchdrops]Twitch Drop[/url] or two, too… 

While every player has a full gameplay loop at their fingertips - Towerborne is still in Steam Early Access and Xbox Game Preview; but so far, on our road to the 1.0 launch, we’ve fielded fantastic feedback from our Founders - those of you who’ve chosen to commit to playing and building with us. Keep it coming. Hit us up on Discord. And let’s keep redefining looter brawlers, together. [h2]New Class Skills [/h2]Introducing the Class Skills Progression System! As you level up your Class, unlock a huge variety of Skills across 5 categories: Focus Skills, Weapon Mechanic, Moveset, Advanced Combat, and Support. Spend Skill Points to Equip or Unequip Skills on the fly (provided you have the points), allowing for deep customization. Mix and match skills and weapons, blend builds with certain combat tactics for different results. Craft a build that truly suits your playstyle! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/5b24125797f214d08fcec51efbbcf1838e8f32aa.png[/img] [h2]Legendary Loot[/h2]Prepare for the hunt! We've added new Legendary Weapons for every class and new Legendary Gear items, dropping in Danger Level 5 content, including specific items from Boss Lairs. The powerful Boomguard's set also joins the DL5 loot pool. We've updated substats on many existing Legendaries, adjusted how rarity impacts Class Level requirements, and revamped Aspects – there are now 3 types (Helm, Chest, Weapon) you can equip 1 of each, changing build possibilities (note: Leg items no longer have Aspect slots). Some overly common Legendaries are now rarer. [h2]World Map, Reimagined[/h2]The entire World Map has been reimagined for better flow and variety. Discover new Chance Encounters, now with custom map art hinting at their contents and deeper ties to nearby Ventures. Explore updated Venture Danger Levels, tackle the new Mossbosk Venture at DL 5, experience adjusted narratives in areas like the Backhills, and meet two new Umbra: Boshi and Querida! Ace XP rewards for exploration have also been rebalanced and generally increased.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/b67e617eaca5c4ce923c0c28e79d5e67f9178329.png[/img] [h2]Gameplay & Quality of Life Updates[/h2]We've smoothed out gameplay with fixes like improved input buffering (making air attacks after jump cancels more reliable), adjusted Universal Block Break to be faster and allow Jump Cancels, made Powderkeg Punch cancels more reliable, and tweaked Shadow Feint activation. Plus, enjoy numerous UI/UX improvements detailed below!Connecting is easier than ever! The Group Finder now automatically matches you based on Goal and Danger Level. The Social Menu clearly shows friends in-game at the top and indicates players looking for a group. Interact directly with players in the Tower or on the World Map to group up, view profiles, or add friends – including cross-platform Stoic Friends! You can also now participate in Towerborne Twitch drop campaigns and link your Steam and Xbox accounts.[h2]The Details[/h2]When it comes to new skill trees (for each class) and a whole lot of map and missions to explore and conquer ... the devil is in more than just the details, it's in playing the game. You'll find a detailed breakdown below of what this update has to offer. But the real magic happens when you feel it come together amongst your friends and foes out in the field of battle. [h2]Gameplay[/h2][list][*][b]General[/b][list][*]Updated Gear Score calculation that includes factors like Class Level and spent Skill Points to give a more accurate result.[*]Rebalanced Ace XP rewards for World Map exploration, in general increasing the amount of AXP awarded.[list][*]Reward POIs[list][*]Initial Exploration: 25 -> 60 AXP[/list][*]Discovery Missions[list][*]Initial Exploration: 50 -> 90 AXP[*]Repeat Exploration: 10 -> 30 AXP[/list][*]Encounter POIs[list][*]Initial Exploration: 75 -> 120 AXP[*]Repeat Exploration: 15 -> 40 AXP[/list][*]Standard Venture Missions[list][*]Initial Exploration: 100 -> 150 AXP[*]Repeat Exploration: 20 -> 50 AXP[/list][*]Boss Lair Venture Missions[list][*]Initial Exploration: 150 -> 180 AXP[*]Repeat Exploration: 30 -> 60 AXP[/list][/list][*]Updated Class Level Requirements for items to include the item's rarity into the calculation. So that higher rarity items require a higher class level to equip.[/list][*][b]Items[/b][list][*]New Legendary Weapons for every class![list][*]These can drop anywhere in Danger Level 5.[/list][*]New Legendary Gear items![list][*]Each Boss Lair venture now can drop one of these items in Danger Level 5.[/list][*]Added the Boomguard's set as new Danger Level 5 venture drops.[*]Boss Weapons will no longer roll with any static substats.[*]Updated substats on many Legendary items.[list][*]Affected Legendary items: Feral's Bane, The Fumigator, Whimsical Dream, Goji's Echo, Power of the Echoes, The Breezy Knees, Whimsical Aspiration[/list][*]Changed the perk on the Trambler's Gear Set to "Flask Uses +1 and Flask Healing +5%" now that the Mender's Flask has replaced the previous Lives mechanic.[*]Updated the look of exploding mushrooms spawned by The Fumigator legendary belt.[*]Feral's Bane legendary daggers renamed to Crowbo's Bane.[*]Aspect Update![list][*]There are now 3 types of aspects and aspect slots instead of 2.[list][*]The player can equip 1 of each, rather than 1 weapon aspect and 3 gear aspects[*]Diamond-shaped Gear Aspects are now Helm Aspects[*]Circle-shaped Chest Aspects have been added[*]Leg items no longer have aspect slots[/list][/list][/list][*][b]Balance[/b][list][*]Ace HP increased by 20% across the board. This was done to offset other changes this release that were lowering Ace survivability.[*]Somewhat Increased values on various item substats:[list][*]DEF[*]DMG Reduction[*]Crit DMG[*]Bleed Duration[*]Burn Duration[*]Poison Duration[*]HP[*]Umbra Ability Duration[*]Umbra Cooldown[/list][*]Slightly decreased values for ATK substat values.[*]Swapped a number of item substats between the prefix and suffix rolling pools[list][*]Moved to Prefix[list][*]Attack[*]Umbra Strength[/list][*]Moved to Suffix[list][*]Affliction Duration[*]Boon Duration[*]Bleed Duration[*]Burn Duration[*]Poison Duration[*]Damage Reduction[*]HP Regeneration[/list][/list][/list][h2]Exploration[/h2][list][*][b]Reimagined World Map[/b][list][*]The entire world map has been adjusted to create a better flow and add more variety.[*]New Chance Encounters have been added. [*]Chance Encounters now have custom art on the world map, hinting at what can be found in the mission.[*]Chance Encounters have been updated to better tie into the Ventures that they are close to and add more context to what is happening in that area of the world.[*]Certain Venture missions have changed Danger Levels:[list][*]Hollowgrass Steppes is now available at Danger Level 2.[*]Dimcap Forest is now available at Danger Level 3.[*]Haljaran is now available at Danger Level 3.[*]Yxil’s Domain is now available at Danger Level 4.[*]Numbers Ironworks is now available at Danger Level 4.[/list] [*]Mossbosk, a new Venture, has been added to Danger Level 5.[*]Ventures narrative updates:[list][*]Certain repetitive moments in ventures have been removed and instead added to Chance Encounters missions.[*]Backhills Venture and the area surrounding it has been adjusted narratively. Because of this the anomaly for the Venture has changed.[/list][*]Certain Umbra missions have changed Danger Levels and biomes.[*]Two new Umbra have been added: Boshi and Querida.[*]The Brawler, a new merk enemy, has been added to the game and can be found in missions with their merc buddies in Danger Level 4. [/list][*][b]Quest Reorganization[/b][list][*]A Return to Form now introduces new mechanics like equipable Skills.[*]More Primary quests have been added.[*]More Side quests have been added. [*]Venture quests have been removed and subsumed into either Primary or Side quests.[/list] [*][b]Request Board[/b][list][*]The Job Board has been renamed to the Request Board. [*]Request Board appearance has been updated. [*]More requests are available. Players will see a guaranteed variety of requests daily. [*]Four requests will be available daily instead of three. [list] [*]During certain events/activities, more requests will be made available, e.g. Golden Week. [/list] [*]Request rewards have been adjusted. [/list] [/list][h2]Combat & Classes[/h2] The Class Skills system adds a whole new world of possibilities to each Class. It’s up to you to pick and choose your Skills in a way that best suits your playstyle. [list] [*][b]Class Skills Progression System[/b] [list] [*]One of the biggest changes to combat comes in the form of Class Skills. This new progression mechanic aims to provide players with a large variety of choice and customization options that unlock as you level up your Classes. [*]Each Skill has a Skill Point Cost associated with it. However, spending points is not a permanent action. You are able to Equip or Unequip Skills however you like, provided you have enough points to do so. There are five main categories to customize: Focus Skills, Weapon Mechanic, Moveset, Advanced Combat, and Support. [/list] [*][b]New! The Mender’s Flask[/b] [list] [*]The concept of Lives has been removed from the game. It is now replaced by the Mender’s Flask. Pressing Up on the d-pad will allow the Ace to heal 40% of your health. In solo play, reaching zero health will now result in Defeat. [list] [*]It will be possible to improve various aspects of Healing as you progress through the game. [/list] [*]By default, the max number of Mender’s Flasks is 1. [*]Interacting with a Shrine refills the Mender’s Flask by 1. [*]Defeating LTs provides a guaranteed Mender’s Flask drop. [list] [*]Run towards the Flask to pick it up. [/list] [/list] [*][b]Focus Skills[/b] are no longer locked to specific weapons. Instead, Focus Skills are unlocked via leveling up the Class of your choice. This means it’s now possible to mix and match your favorite Light and Heavy Focus Skills! [*][b]Weapon Mechanics[/b] have been greatly expanded thanks to the new Skill system. Some of the new Skills provide small tweaks or improvements to existing mechanics, while others provide all new opportunities that drastically change the way you play. [*]The Ace’s Standard Moveset can also be expanded with new Skills. You’ll be able to perform air evades, recover quickly when launched, or even perform wake up attacks after being knocked down. [*]Advanced Combat is where you add new moves, modify existing moves, or apply unique perks to your Class. Some of these are pretty wild, so please look forward to checking them all out! [*]The Support category is where you can modify your Class to do things that help you when times are tough. Need more Mender’s Flasks? Want to help heal your party? Want to survive a devastating attack that normally would lead to defeat? [/list] [h3]General [/h3]Due to the new Class Skill system, there are a lot of changes under the hood that may not be listed here. Instead, some of the bigger highlights will be shared. However, it’s worth noting that general gameplay should feel much improved even if it’s not specifically called out. [list] [*]Fixed an issue across all gameplay that prevented inputs from being buffered correctly when pressed very quickly. This should result in air attacks to be performed more reliably after jump canceling an Evade. [*]Rising Recovery is now a Skill that unlocks at Level 5. This action allows you to quickly rise from the ground by pressing Jump or Evade. [*]Universal Launchers are now gated by Skill progression and unlocks at Level 7. tags.feature: Introducing the Class Skills Progression System! As you level up your Class, unlock a huge variety of Skills across 5 categories: Focus Skills, Weapon Mechanic, Moveset, Advanced Combat, and Support. Spend Skill Points to Equip or Unequip Skills on the fly (provided you have the points), allowing for deep customization. Mix and match skills and weapons, blend builds with certain combat tactics for different results. Craft a build that truly suits your playstyle!

We've added new Legendary Weapons for every class and new Legendary Gear items, dropping in Danger Level 5 content, including specific items from Boss Lairs. The powerful Boomguard's set also joins the DL5 loot pool. We've updated substats on many existing Legendaries, adjusted how rarity impacts Class Level requirements, and revamped Aspects – there are now 3 types (Helm, Chest, Weapon) you can equip 1 of each, changing build possibilities (note: Leg items no longer have Aspect slots). Some overly common Legendaries are now rarer.

The entire World Map has been reimagined for better flow and variety. Discover new Chance Encounters, now with custom map art hinting at their contents and deeper ties to nearby Ventures. Explore updated Venture Danger Levels, tackle the new Mossbosk Venture at DL 5, experience adjusted narratives in areas like the Backhills, and meet two new Umbra: Boshi and Querida! Ace XP rewards for exploration have also been rebalanced and generally increased.

We've smoothed out gameplay with fixes like improved input buffering (making air attacks after jump cancels more reliable), adjusted Universal Block Break to be faster and allow Jump Cancels, made Powderkeg Punch cancels more reliable, and tweaked Shadow Feint activation. Plus, enjoy numerous UI/UX improvements detailed below!

The Group Finder now automatically matches you based on Goal and Danger Level. The Social Menu clearly shows friends in-game at the top and indicates players looking for a group. Interact directly with players in the Tower or on the World Map to group up, view profiles, or add friends – including cross-platform Stoic Friends! You can also now participate in Towerborne Twitch drop campaigns and link your Steam and Xbox accounts.
Updated Gear Score calculation that includes factors like Class Level and spent Skill Points to give a more accurate result.

tags.feature: One of the biggest changes to combat comes in the form of Class Skills. This new progression mechanic aims to provide players with a large variety of choice and customization options that unlock as you level up your Classes.

Each Skill has a Skill Point Cost associated with it. However, spending points is not a permanent action. You are able to Equip or Unequip Skills however you like, provided you have enough points to do so. There are five main categories to customize: Focus Skills, Weapon Mechanic, Moveset, Advanced Combat, and Support.

The concept of Lives has been removed from the game. It is now replaced by the Mender’s Flask. Pressing Up on the d-pad will allow the Ace to heal 40% of your health. In solo play, reaching zero health will now result in Defeat.
It will be possible to improve various aspects of Healing as you progress through the game.
By default, the max number of Mender’s Flasks is 1.
Interacting with a Shrine refills the Mender’s Flask by 1.
Defeating LTs provides a guaranteed Mender’s Flask drop.

Focus Skills are no longer locked to specific weapons. Instead, Focus Skills are unlocked via leveling up the Class of your choice. This means it’s now possible to mix and match your favorite Light and Heavy Focus Skills!

Weapon Mechanics have been greatly expanded thanks to the new Skill system. Some of the new Skills provide small tweaks or improvements to existing mechanics, while others provide all new opportunities that drastically change the way you play.
The Ace’s Standard Moveset can also be expanded with new Skills. You’ll be able to perform air evades, recover quickly when launched, or even perform wake up attacks after being knocked down.
Advanced Combat is where you add new moves, modify existing moves, or apply unique perks to your Class. Some of these are pretty wild, so please look forward to checking them all out!

The Support category is where you can modify your Class to do things that help you when times are tough. Need more Mender’s Flasks? Want to help heal your party? Want to survive a devastating attack that normally would lead to defeat?

notes.title: Class Spotlight: Pyroclast
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/185d6ce2f73e67a85447ab5bf696faa99da4f8d4.png[/img]
[h2]Overview[/h2]
The Pyroclast brandishes the Warclub, favoring deliberate, earth-shaking swings that reward patience with explosive payoff. Charge the Heat Gauge to ignite every strike, bathing foes in lingering fire while a built-in Grit frame lets you shrug off interruptions and finish each colossal arc. With sweeping crowd control and escalating Burn damage the Pyroclast embodies methodical devastation—perfect for Aces who relish turning raw force into a blazing battlefield.
[previewyoutube=ycs_TbqblMQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Weapon: Warclub
[/h2]The Warclub isn't subtle—it’s the weapon for anyone who enjoys hearing their enemies go "crunch." Slow, satisfying strikes deal huge damage and literally set your foes on fire. It’s not fancy, but it doesn’t need to be. If the phrase "brute force" appeals, you've found your match.
[list]
[*] Big hits that demand commitment but pay off explosively.
[*] Crowd control, fiery style.
[*] Ignite enemies—because roasting foes never gets old.[/list] [h2]Weapon Mechanic[/h2]
These are Skills that modify the weapon mechanic (the RB button). Could be expansions to the mechanic, additional options, or even a full on change that makes it feel like something else entirely. 
[list]
[*] Sear: When the Weapon Meter is full, press RB to activate Sear (12s). All attacks inflict Burn (3s) while Sear is active. Burn: deals low damage 4 times per second
[*] Searing Burst: When activating Sear, trigger a huge explosion that deals damage and inflicts Burn (3s) on each enemy hit. Burn: deals low damage 4 times per second
[*] Infernal Touch: When activating Sear, grant nearby allies Fired Up (6s). Fired Up: Inflict Burn (2s) per hit Burn: deals low damage 4 times per second
[*] Preheat: Press RB to automatically charge Sear by 1% for 10 seconds.
[*] Pyro Surge: Press RB while attacking to quickly recover and charge Sear. While Sear is active, press RB while attacking to perform an area attack around the Ace.
[*] Persistent Pyre: Increases the duration of Sear by 4s.
[*] Persistent Pyre II: Increases the duration of Sear by 4s.
[*] Hot Air: While Sear is active, deal 15% more damage to Airborne enemies.
[*] Ember Lunge: While Sear is active, press RB while Evading to perform an explosive flying kick.
[*] Ember Cyclone: While Sear is active, press RB while Airborne to perform a spinning attack.
[*] Ember Spike: While Sear is active, any attacks that impact the ground cause a long-range tremor that travels across the ground and explodes on the first enemy hit. This attack Block Breaks.
[*] Volcanic Wrath: While Sear is active, press RB to use Volcanic Wrath. This attack Block Breaks and consumes Weapon Meter with each use.
[*] Thermal Amplification: Gain +5% additional Weapon Meter when attacking enemies or charging Sear, and +50% Weapon Meter from incoming attacks.
[*] Stable Footing: When activating Sear, gain Stability (5s). Stability: Negates reactions from incoming hits
[*] Intense Heat: +25% Burn DMG while Sear is active.
[*] Ember Cannon: While Sear is active, fire a long-range projectile when performing the Light Evade Attack Finisher.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/056c9684b009709b7fd6c570e0d1e147056c121c.png[/img][h2]Standard Moveset
[/h2]These are Skills that modify your most basic combat skills. Need to do a launcher? Cool! Want to dodge in the air? Recovery quickly when knocked down? This is where you do it. All classes have the same Standard Moveset Skills.
[list]
[*] Airborne Shift: Press B while Airborne to Evade.
[*] Heavy Evade Attack: Press Y after Evading to perform a Heavy Evade Attack (B,Y). Evade canceling an attack followed by a Heavy Attack will perform a unique Combo Finisher.
[*] Light Evade Attack: Press X after Evading to perform a Light Evade Attack (B,X). Evade canceling an attack followed by a Light Attack will perform a unique Combo Finisher.
[*] Airborne Rebound: Press A to recover after getting hit while Airborne.
[*] Rising Recovery: Press A to quickly recover after getting knocked down. Pressing B will execute a Dodge Roll recovery instead.
[*] Block Breaker: Hold Y to perform a Block Breaker attack.
[*] Launcher: Hold X to perform a Launcher attack.
[*] Rising Strike: While laying on the ground, press any attack button (X or Y) to perform a recovery attack.[/list] [h2]Advanced Combat
[/h2]These are Skills that amplify various parts of your Class. It could be related to specific combos, could add additional moves to the kit that are specific to the class (new move, variation of a move, etc). This is where a lot of build crafting comes from.
[list]
[*] Shattering Strikes: All Heavy Attack Combo Finishers now Block Break.
[*] Crushing Momentum: Each hit of the Advanced Heavy Combo (XYYY) deals increasing Break Bar DMG, gaining +5% with each successive hit in the combo.
[*] Fiery Cascade: Attacking Burning enemies spreads Burn (3s) to nearby enemies. Cooldown: 5s Burn: deals low damage 4 times per second
[*] Combustive Finale: Heavy Combo Finisher (YYY) consumes all Burn stacks on the enemy, triggering an explosion. Each stack of Burn increases the explosion damage by 5%.
[*] Cindercharge: All flamethrower attacks and Focus Skills inflict an additional stack of Burn (1s). +2s to the duration if the flamethrower attack scores a critical hit.
[*] Scorched Blast: Trigger an explosion when attacking Burning enemies. Cooldown: 1s
[*] Flame’s Embrace: +50% Burn Resistance. Defeating a Burning enemy causes Burn (3s) to be inflicted on the attacker. While burning, spread Burn (3s) to other enemies on contact. Burn: deals low damage 4 times per second
[*] Unshakable Strength: +10% Strike DMG while Stability is active.
[*] Whirlwind Bash: Upgrades the Air Light Attack to a horizontal spin attack that hits twice.
[*] Cyclone Slam: Upgrades the Heavy Evade Attack to an area spin attack that Launches enemies and then smashes them to the ground. This attack Block Breaks.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/13f648f44011a0685e6ccf04b7f993c74c5a7941.png[/img][h2]Focus Skills
[/h2]Every weapon boasts a roster of high-impact techniques that consume Focus, a meter earned through skillful play. Equip any two outside combat, then unleash them mid-fight to redefine the encounter. Mixing and matching these abilities lets you tailor burst damage, crowd control, or mobility to the mission at hand. 

[i]Your [b]Light Focus Skills[/b] are your 1 bar focus skills. Uses LT + Light Attack to activate. You can only have one of these. Your [b]Heavy Focus Skills[/b] are your 2 bar focus skills. Uses LT + Heavy Attack to activate. You can only have one of these. [/i]
[h3]Light Focus
[/h3][list]
[*] Crimson Uppercut: Press LT+X to unleash a column of flame in a rising spin attack. Enemies are struck 4 times and Launched. Inflicts Burn (2s) on the final hit. Break Bar DMG: Medium
[*] Blast Off: Press LT+X to fire a blast at the ground that Launches the Ace and nearby enemies. While in the air, the Ace will fire a second blast, damaging nearby enemies. Inflicts Burn (2s) on all enemies hit. Break Bar DMG: High
[*] Wildfire: Press LT+X to spin the warclub vertically, pulling in enemies in front and dealing damage. The final blast inflicts Burn (2s) and Stun (2s). Break Bar DMG: Medium
[/list][h3]Heavy Focus
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Blazing Roar: Press LT+Y to unleash a stream of fire from the warclub that hits enemies multiple times and staggers them. Inflicts Burn (1s) on each hit and Burn (3s) on the final hit. This attack can be used while Airborne. Break Bar DMG: High
[*] Seething Cyclone: Press LT+Y to spin around, hitting enemies up to 6 times. The Ace can move freely while spinning. This attack can only be interrupted by Unblockable attacks. Break Bar DMG: High
[*] Mountain Splitter: Press LT+Y to slam the warclub on the ground, creating a seismic wave. Each strike increases the power of the wave, dealing damage to all enemies in front of the Ace. This attack inflicts Burn (5s) on the final hit. Break Bar DMG: High
[/list]

Ember Lunge: While Sear is active, press RB while Evading to perform an explosive flying kick.
Ember Cyclone: While Sear is active, press RB while Airborne to perform a spinning attack.

Volcanic Wrath: While Sear is active, press RB to use Volcanic Wrath. This attack Block Breaks and consumes Weapon Meter with each use.
Thermal Amplification: Gain +5% additional Weapon Meter when attacking enemies or charging Sear, and +50% Weapon Meter from incoming attacks.
Stable Footing: When activating Sear, gain Stability (5s). Stability: Negates reactions from incoming hits
Intense Heat: +25% Burn DMG while Sear is active.
Ember Cannon: While Sear is active, fire a long-range projectile when performing the Light Evade Attack Finisher.
Airborne Shift: Press B while Airborne to Evade.
Heavy Evade Attack: Press Y after Evading to perform a Heavy Evade Attack (B,Y). Evade canceling an attack followed by a Heavy Attack will perform a unique Combo Finisher.

Rising Recovery: Press A to quickly recover after getting knocked down. Pressing B will execute a Dodge Roll recovery instead.
Block Breaker: Hold Y to perform a Block Breaker attack.
Launcher: Hold X to perform a Launcher attack.
Rising Strike: While laying on the ground, press any attack button (X or Y) to perform a recovery attack.
Shattering Strikes: All Heavy Attack Combo Finishers now Block Break.
Crushing Momentum: Each hit of the Advanced Heavy Combo (XYYY) deals increasing Break Bar DMG, gaining +5% with each successive hit in the combo.
Fiery Cascade: Attacking Burning enemies spreads Burn (3s) to nearby enemies. Cooldown: 5s Burn: deals low damage 4 times per second
Combustive Finale: Heavy Combo Finisher (YYY) consumes all Burn stacks on the enemy, triggering an explosion. Each stack of Burn increases the explosion damage by 5%.
Cindercharge: All flamethrower attacks and Focus Skills inflict an additional stack of Burn (1s). +2s to the duration if the flamethrower attack scores a critical hit.
Scorched Blast: Trigger an explosion when attacking Burning enemies. Cooldown: 1s

Flame’s Embrace: +50% Burn Resistance. Defeating a Burning enemy causes Burn (3s) to be inflicted on the attacker. While burning, spread Burn (3s) to other enemies on contact. Burn: deals low damage 4 times per second
Unshakable Strength: +10% Strike DMG while Stability is active.
Whirlwind Bash: Upgrades the Air Light Attack to a horizontal spin attack that hits twice.
Cyclone Slam: Upgrades the Heavy Evade Attack to an area spin attack that Launches enemies and then smashes them to the ground. This attack Block Breaks.
Crimson Uppercut: Press LT+X to unleash a column of flame in a rising spin attack. Enemies are struck 4 times and Launched. Inflicts Burn (2s) on the final hit. Break Bar DMG: Medium

notes.title: Class Spotlight: Rockbreaker
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/c917910d73da7112e55007e5360079175ab9a6fa.png[/img]
[h2]Overview[/h2]
Rockbreakers unleash relentless power through the Gauntlets, chaining rapid jabs into precise uppercuts that culminate in the devastating Powderkeg Punch. Their combat rhythm hinges on landing high-impact Enders: complete a ground combo, detonate a charged haymaker, then juggle targets for sustained single-target melt. Vulnerable during the wind-up yet unmatched when it lands, the Rockbreaker rewards calculated aggression and mastery of timing to dominate bosses and brawls alike.
[previewyoutube=Zzyw8xMnsAo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Weapon: Guantlets
[/h2]
Gauntlets turn you into a pure melee powerhouse, mixing swift jabs with crushing finishers. Combos are king here—land them consistently to unlock massive damage potential. It's all about timing, precision, and knowing exactly when to unleash your inner juggernaut.
[list]
[*] In-your-face melee with unmatched single-target devastation.
[*] Combo finishers that pack a wallop.
[*] Ground combat that'll have you feeling every punch.
[/list][h2]Weapon Mechanic[/h2]
These are Skills that modify the weapon mechanic (the RB button). Could be expansions to the mechanic, additional options, or even a full on change that makes it feel like something else entirely. [list]
[*] Powderkeg Drop: Hold RB to charge Powderkeg Punch while Airborne.
[*] Cracking Knuckles: Gain a fully charged Powderkeg Punch after Block Breaking an enemy.
[*] Keg Toss: Using a fully charged Powderkeg Punch sends enemies flying into other enemies, knocking them back on impact.
[*] Cracking Skulls: Gain a fully charged Powderkeg Punch after breaking an enemy's Break Bar.
[*] Desperate Fury: When reaching Critical HP (25% or lower), gain a fully charged Powderkeg Punch. Cooldown: 10s
[*] Unbreakable Charge: Gain Stability while charging Powderkeg Punch. Stability: Negates reactions from incoming hits
[*] Stored Resilience: When a fully charged Powderkeg Punch is stored, gain Stability (4s). Stability is removed if the punch is used before the duration expires. Stability: Negates reactions from incoming hits
[*] Bare Knuckle Blast: Replaces Powderkeg Punch with Bare Knuckle Blast, a powerful lunging strike that propels forward. Press RB the moment the Weapon Meter is full to execute a Precise Punch that deals increased damage, Launches, and inflicts Stun (3s).
[*] Powderkeg Punch: Hold RB to charge Powderkeg Punch. This attack has 3 charge levels that increase in power. A full charge can be stored for up to 15 seconds. The Weapon Meter stat increases the charge speed of this attack. Press RB the moment the Weapon Meter is full to execute a Precise Punch that deals increased damage, Launches, and inflicts Stun (3s).
[*] Quick Charge I: Powderkeg Punch charges 20% faster (stacks with other charge sources).
[*] Quick Charge II: Powderkeg Punch charges 20% faster (stacks with other charge sources).
[*] Quick Charge III: Powderkeg Punch charges 20% faster (stacks with other charge sources).
[*] Critical Impact: +50% Crit Chance when using Powderkeg Punch.
[*] Stunny Delight: With a fully charged Powderkeg Punch stored, each hit has a 20% chance to inflict Stun (1s).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/9b1535a25578062b420917118a8c3c5de5c49815.png[/img]
[h2]Standard Moveset
[/h2]These are Skills that modify your most basic combat skills. Need to do a launcher? Cool! Want to dodge in the air? Recovery quickly when knocked down? This is where you do it. All classes have the same Standard Moveset Skills.
[list]
[*] Airborne Shift: Press B while Airborne to Evade.
[*] Heavy Evade Attack: Press Y after Evading to perform a Heavy Evade Attack (B,Y). Evade canceling an attack followed by a Heavy Attack will perform a unique Combo Finisher.
[*] Light Evade Attack: Press X after Evading to perform a Light Evade Attack (B,X). Evade canceling an attack followed by a Light Attack will perform a unique Combo Finisher.
[*] Airborne Rebound: Press A to recover after getting hit while Airborne.
[*] Rising Recovery: Press A to quickly recover after getting knocked down. Pressing B will execute a Dodge Roll recovery instead.
[*] Block Breaker: Hold Y to perform a Block Breaker attack.
[*] Launcher: Hold X to perform a Launcher attack.
[*] Rising Strike: While laying on the ground, press any attack button (X or Y) to perform a recovery attack.[/list]
[h2]Advanced Combat
[/h2]These are Skills that amplify various parts of your Class. It could be related to specific combos, could add additional moves to the kit that are specific to the class (new move, variation of a move, etc). This is where a lot of build crafting comes from.
[list]
[*] Slam Dunk: Press X while Airborne to slam enemies down into a Ground Bounce.
[*] Combat High: After hitting an enemy 10 times within 10 seconds, generate Focus for 7 seconds.
[*] Endless Barrage: Continue pressing X after the Advanced Light Combo (YXXX) to infinitely pummel enemies.
[*] Bob & Weave: +5% DMG after successfully evading an attack (max 30%). Resets after getting hit.
[*] Breaking Point: Upgrades the Light Evade Attack Finisher to Block Break enemies on hit.
[*] Rampaging Blows: Combo Finishers increase Break Bar DMG by 2% (max 20%). Resets after getting hit.
[*] Rumbling Elbow Drop: Air Heavy Attack creates a small shockwave when executed at max height.
[*] Stone Cold: Combo Finishers and Powderkeg Punch deal 15% more damage and have increased knockback.
[*] Double Lariat: Upgrades the Light Evade Attack duration and hit count. This attack Block Breaks on the final hit.
[*] Torpedo Dropkick: Hold Y after evading to charge the dropkick into a Torpedo Dropkick, dealing increased damage and Block Breaking enemies.
[*] Atomic Shockwave: Hold Y on the last hit of the Advanced Heavy Combo (XYYY) to slam the ground, creating a massive shockwave.
[*] Cloudsweeper: Perform an Airborne 3-hit Light Attack Combo that slams enemies down on the final hit.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/7edd4ba11aac028fea4b74bf09d8e3ef4e193b67.png[/img]
[h2]Focus Skills
[/h2]Every weapon boasts a roster of high-impact techniques that consume Focus, a meter earned through skillful play. Equip any two outside combat, then unleash them mid-fight to redefine the encounter. Mixing and matching these abilities lets you tailor burst damage, crowd control, or mobility to the mission at hand. 

[i]Your [b]Light Focus Skills[/b] are your 1 bar focus skills. Uses LT + Light Attack to activate. You can only have one of these. Your [b]Heavy Focus Skills[/b] are your 2 bar focus skills. Uses LT + Heavy Attack to activate. You can only have one of these. [/i]
[h3]Light Focus
[/h3][list]
[*] Dual Eclipse: Press LT+X to execute a sweeping 2-hit area combo that unleashes a shockwave that travels across the ground. Enemies hit are knocked back. Break Bar DMG: Medium
[*] Counter Argument: Press LT+X to briefly enter a defensive stance that can Parry an incoming attack. All damage is increased by 20% for 5 seconds (damage bonus stacks, duration does not). Increases Powderkeg Punch charge speed by 25% (stacks). After a successful parry, press any attack button to slam the ground, unleashing a shockwave counter-attack.
[*] Standing Ovation: Press LT+X to unleash a massive clap, causing all surrounding enemies to take damage and be knocked back. This attack can be used while Airborne. Break Bar DMG: High
[/list][h3]Heavy Focus
[/h3]
[list][*] Skyward Swing: Press LT+Y to unleash a multi-hit combo that deals damage and Launches enemies, followed by a swirling vortex that deals damage on contact. Break Bar DMG: High
[*] Relentless Barrage: Press LT+Y to quickly dash forward and execute a 6-hit combo, inflicting Stun (4s). This attack can be used while Airborne. Break Bar DMG: High
[*] Jackhammer: Press LT+Y to deliver a series of ground-shaking punches, unleashing a devastating 5-hit area attack. Enemies hit are Launched. Break Bar DMG: High
[/list]

notes.title: Class Spotlight: Shadowstriker
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/d41547692a18a826bd3188fdc3463d83b8f3f83b.png[/img]
[h2]Overview
[/h2] Shadowstrikers dance across the field with Dual Daggers, weaving blinding multi-hit flurries and seamless Aerial Juggles into a relentless assault. The hallmark Shadow Feint teleport hurls a dagger, blinking you instantly to its mark—perfect for gap-closing bursts or evasive retreats. High mobility, precision hit-count scaling, and stylish combo routes make the Shadowstriker the weapon of choice for Aces who thrive on speed, fluid repositioning, and “death-by-a-thousand-cuts” finesse.
[previewyoutube=xTITfG18K94;full]
[/previewyoutube]
[h2]Weapon: Dual Daggers
[/h2]Dual Daggers are for the combo connoisseurs and style savants—fast strikes, aerial antics, and the thrill of staying one step ahead. Every move counts. Master this weapon and dance through the battlefield, dealing death by a thousand (ridiculously cool) cuts.
[list]
[*] Fast and flashy multi-hit combos.
[*] Air juggling to embarrass your foes stylishly.
[*] Evasive strikes and teleportation because moving normally is overrated.
[/list]
[h2]Weapon Mechanic[/h2]
These are Skills that modify the weapon mechanic (the RB button). Could be expansions to the mechanic, additional options, or even a full on change that makes it feel like something else entirely. 
[list]
[*] [b]Shadow Drift[/b]: Press RB to perform Shadow Feint while Airborne.
[*] [b]Shadow Feint[/b]: Press RB to throw a dagger that deals damage on impact, then teleport to its location and deliver a follow-up attack. This attack Block Breaks. At the start of a mission, 1 bar of the Weapon Meter is automatically filled. The teleport direction can be influenced diagonally by pressing Up or Down when activating this attack.
[*] [b]Shadow Feint Ammo I[/b]: Increases the Weapon Meter by 1.
[*] [b]Shadow Feint Ammo II[/b]: Increases the Weapon Meter by 1.
[*] [b]Shadow Feint Ammo III[/b]: Increases the Weapon Meter by 1.
[*] [b]Shadow's Edge[/b]: Combo Finishers deal 2% more damage after successfully hitting an enemy with Shadow Feint (max 20%).
[*] [b]Shadow Dancer[/b]: Gain Stealth (6s) when scoring a critical hit with Shadow Feint. Stealth: Undetectable by enemies until dealing or taking damage
[*] [b]Venomburst[/b]: When successfully hitting an enemy with Shadow Feint, trigger a delayed explosion after 3 seconds. The explosion inflicts Poison (3s). Cooldown: 4s Poison: deals high damage once per second
[*] [b]Shadowsting[/b]: Press RB to perform Shadowsting. Shadowsting does not teleport but instead inflicts Poison (3s). This attack consumes half a bar of Weapon Meter per use. Poison: deals high damage once per second
[*] [b]Silent Strike[/b]: While in Stealth, Shadow Feint deals 50% more damage.
[*] [b]Silent Resupply[/b]: Automatically generate Weapon Meter while Stealth is active.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237228/83c1823502bbfbbf7e2a58568b6377cc99cb9635.png[/img]
